title: Twyman-Green interferometer — 1064 nm laser
description: The Twyman-Green interferometer is a interferometer specified here at 1064 nm laser. Spherical aberration: wavefront error from imperfect optics under test. Astigmatism: uneven curvature that splits the interference focus. Corrected with aspherical lens elements. Typical use: vibration analysis.

aberration_notes: Spherical aberration: wavefront error from imperfect optics under test.
Astigmatism: uneven curvature that splits the interference focus.
